scope: Original-only owned relative path/Source current-file and original index-worker lifecycle oracle; native path context pending
observed_rules: Selected first-truthy extracted/file/cache path; missing selected extracted path does not fall back.
Relative paths resolve against actual /app CWD; MEDIA_ROOT /app/media is an ordinary directory in this fixture.
Symlink/../ traverses actual target parent; no lexical path simplification or variable/tilde expansion.
File absence precedes clock/index; normal path clock precedes fresh index, then file open.
Interleaved current lookup independently opens twice; controlled atomic replacement is observed by forward open; deletion raises FileNotFoundError.
Root chmod000 still reads, while uid65534 original helper raises PermissionError on same owned file.
limitations: No existing-volume/cutover/restart migration or native app path wiring.
Original worker ran as UID0 in controlled fixture; production UID policy needs packaged migration rehearsal.
Source paths are not artificially contained; future native configured resource limits are separate compatibility boundaries.
